description: Use of the basement as ancillary classroom (D1) and yoga studio (D2) in conjunction with the ground floor shop/cafe (A1)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1905/ L.01, 1905- F.02 and 1905-F.03 - received 28/11/19) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for Creche and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class  D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for Yoga studio and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 5 - The use of the building within Use Class D2 shall not be open to customers outside of the following hours: 9:00am - 9:00pm Monday to Saturday; 9:00am-9:00pm, Sundays and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 6 - The creche and yoga studio (D1/D2) uses hereby permitted shall be confined to the basement floor of the premises only.
Condition : 7 - The uses within the basement shall remain ancillary and subservient to the primary use of the site on the ground floor and shall not become separate or dominant uses at any time.
